keep_notes.title: Google Keep Notes
keep_notes.description: Keep notes persisted in Firestore, enabling categorization, labels, pinned sorting, color styling, and checklists.

id.description: The unique document ID of the note

userId.description: The Google User ID representing the owner of this note

title.description: Heading or title of the note

content.description: The text body or JSON string containing checklist items

color.description: A tailwind-compatible color theme select for the card

isPinned.description: True if the note card is prioritized/pinned at top

isArchived.description: True if the note card is archived

labels.description: A list of category classification strings

/keep_notes/{noteId}.description: Access points containing Keep Notes for individual users, restricted by request authentication owner ID
